stories.headline: FTC opens investigation into OpenAI and Anthropic over consumer harm
stories.blurb: The Federal Trade Commission is examining whether the two leading AI labs violated laws against unfair and deceptive business practices. The probe marks the agency's most direct regulatory action against frontier AI companies to date.
stories.why_it_matters: Major AI labs now face federal scrutiny that could reshape how they deploy models and communicate capabilities.
stories.original_headline: F.T.C. Investigates OpenAI and Anthropic Over Potential Consumer Harms

stories.headline: DoorDash just launched an AI agent you can text to order food
stories.blurb: DoorDash now lets you text an AI agent to place orders instead of using the app. The company is betting conversational ordering will help it compete with Uber Eats and Grubhub, especially for people who find apps too clunky or slow.
stories.why_it_matters: Ordering food by text could become faster than tapping through menus in an app.
stories.original_headline: DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food

stories.headline: Google is now paying publishers to show up in AI search results
stories.blurb: Google launched a pilot with roughly 100 publishers who get paid when their content appears in AI-generated search answers. The move comes as publishers worry AI overviews are killing their traffic by answering questions directly instead of sending clicks to their sites.
stories.why_it_matters: First major search engine to share revenue with the sources its AI is summarizing.
stories.original_headline: Google reportedly tests paying publishers for AI search results

stories.headline: DeepMind can now watermark AI-generated proteins without breaking them
stories.blurb: Google's SynthID Bio embeds invisible watermarks into protein sequences that AI generates. The watermark survives in the actual folded protein and doesn't affect how it works biologically. Researchers can detect whether a protein came from a model, even after it's been synthesized in a lab.
stories.why_it_matters: You can now track AI-designed proteins in the wild without compromising their function.
